bio: Sebastiano Grimani hails from a distinguished Cittadini family whose mercantile acumen has earned them respect throughout the Venetian Republic. Recently elevated to the Cittadini class through his shrewd management of property holdings, Sebastiano possesses a contemplative demeanor that masks his calculating business mind.
